# `gridView` (Content)

<!-- GENERATED by `dart run tool/reference.dart`. Do not edit. -->

Scrollable grid. `itemBuilder` is built once per item of `data`.

| Prop | Kind | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `data` | value |  |
| `itemBuilder` | node | values and actions inside get `index` |
| `empty` | node |  |
| `columns` | literal | default 2 |
| `spacing` | literal |  |
| `aspectRatio` | literal | item width / height, default 1 |

Kinds are explained in REFERENCE.md (Widgets). Icons, colors and text variants: style.md.
